title: A Orbit for the Archive
author: C. M. Dunmore
blurb: Ulyana Sandoval, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
